p.s: Dear Sir/Madam,
I am writing to express my dissatisfaction about the musical show I had seen yesterday, called 'Over The Rainbow'.
Firstly, I was disapointed, because the actor Danny Brook did not appeared in the show.
Then, another thing I would like to mention is that the time advertised was wrong, because the show started at 20:15.
Another thing is that there were discounts on the price of the tickets, and I did not have any discount.
It also puts that there was a restaurant to eat in after the show, but it was closed because it was not completely built.
Finally, I would like to know why would have a perfect evening, because I did not have one, so I would like to have my money back.
I look forward to hearing from you in the very near future.
Yours faithfully,
Juan Almo Dali

Pat did not answer to him.
